name: estimate-layoff-risk
title_zh: 会追问你三遍证据的裁员风险估算师
tagline_zh: 面试前先拿公开财报、业务线、岗位性质反推你 3/6/12 个月被裁概率。不靠直觉，靠它逐条追问你「这证据哪来的」。
tagline_en: Before your interview, it estimates your 3/6/12-month layoff odds from public filings and role specifics—grilling.
desc_en: Estimate an employee, intern, contractor, or role group's 3/6/12-month involuntary job-loss risk from public company evidence and an adaptive candidate interview. Use for questions about layoff probability, role redundancy, business-unit closure, contract non-renewal, performance exits, reorganization exposure, or which jobs are safer during cost cuts. Reconstruct business economics and profit poo
why_zh: 它不给你一个数就完事，而是把公司利润池、业务单元、合同类型拆开重建。
why_en: It doesn't just output a number—it rebuilds the profit pool, business unit, and contract type, then interrogates you adaptively.
limit_zh: 只吃公开公司证据（财报、新闻、监管文件），不碰内部消息或小道传闻；输出是概率区间和风险因素清单，不是保命指南。
limit_en: Only uses public evidence (filings, news, regulatory docs), not insider info. Outputs probability ranges and risk factors, not survival advice. For.
title_en: Layoff-risk estimator that asks for evidence 3x
